title: AI stock sell-off spreads from Wall Street to Asia after US midterms
caption:
A sell-off in AI stocks has spread from Wall Street to Asia. The Nasdaq fell 5.5% on Thursday and South Korea's Kospi dropped more than 8% on Friday, triggering a trading halt, Reuters reports. Investors fear Democrats, who won both houses of Congress, could slow the building of AI data centres.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
